content.title: 2021 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of acute and chronic heart failure - Reviewers
content.note: Declarations of interest reported to the ESC by experts during the yearly call for declaration covering the previous calendar year (up to and including 2020).

experts.name: Uuetoa Tiina
declarations: Payment from healthcare industry to department or institution for personal services: speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member, etc.

Other positions of influence: membership/affiliation in political, advocacy or patients organisations; member of working group by the Estonian Health Insurance Foundation in developing National Guidelines for Primary Care Physicians for the management of chronic heart failure (unpaid contribution); Co-Head of the National Heart Failure Nurse Curriculum Committee (unpaid contribution).
